name: 0512FarmerJump
author: Jasonlin778
description:
How to control your characters :
(1)Press space to jump , you can triple jump if you press it three times.
(2)Press shift to dash , double scores , higher speeds , and more excitement!
As a soft reminder : If you play this game for the first time , you can practice without dashing . But after you get more skillful , just dash straight as many times as you can!
If you don’t want to read obstacles introduction , I allow you to  read section 7 merely.
Rumor has it that when a plane crash the stone arch , a catastrophe will strike immediately. ? _ ?
My best score is 11960 😈, can u beat me? :) Good Luck!


Obstacles introduction :
Be cautious ! Although you can leap three times in a row , there are seven sorts of cunning obstacles on the way to prevent you from going through the route!

Common kinds:
(1)garbage cans : They queue up tightly , just dash and jump to dodge them!
(2)stone arch : Do not double jumps , unless you consider you can hop to the sky and run very fast!
(3)triple boxes : Triple jumps always go along with triple boxes ! Double jumps to get rid of them.

Special kinds:
(4)plane : They only circle in the air , but they always remain at the same speed!
(5)Orange caps : Showing up with unity , orange caps always appear four times in a row.
(6)Stone walls : It is really crafty of them to blind your horizons ! Only dashing enables them to move faster.
(7)White fences : White fences never comes single , their color are the same as the ground , make sure that you are concentrate on observing the road every now and then .After the first white fence passes through , the second one will show up in random time and random position . Just like invisible ghost twins.

description:
ดูหนังออนไลน์ Tee Yod 2 [ธี่หยด 2] หนังออนไลน์ฟรี เต็มเรื่อง HD พากย์ไทย,ธี่หยด 2- เต็มเรื่อง FULL HD/4K พากย์ไทย. ดูหนัง ธี่หยด 2 2023 พากย์ไทย เต็มเรื่อง (THAI-DUBBED),ธี่หยด 2 พากย์ไทย 1080p, [ดู] ธี่หยด 2 [THAI] พากย์ไท, (ดูหนัง!ธี่หยด 2 TEEYOD) ออนไลน์ฟรี ~หนัง! ธี่หยด 2 เต็มเรื่อง หนังฟรี หนัง 8K-HD ธี่หยด 2 Tee Yod 2 2023, ดูหนังใหม่ 2023 | #ธี่หยด 2

🎬▶ ดูออนไลน์หนัง ► https://t.co/ynObHk3VIu

🎬▶ ดูออนไลน์หนัง ► https://t.co/ynObHk3VIu

ธี่หยด 2 (อังกฤษ: Death Whisperer 2;Tee Yod 2) เป็นภาพยนตร์ไทยแนวสยองขวัญเหนือธรรมชาติ ที่กำลังจะมาถึง เป็นภาคต่อจากธี่หยด กำกับโดย คุ้ย ทวีวัฒน์ วันทา และนำแสดงโดย ณเดชน์ คูกิมิยะ เดนิส เจลีลชา คัปปุน กาจบัณฑิต ใจดี พีระกฤตย์ พชรบุณยเกียรติ ณัฐชา นีน่า เจสซิกา พาโดวัน พีรวิชญ์ อรรถชิตสถาพร อริศรา วงษ์ชาลี และ ปรเมศร์ น้อยอ่ำ เช่นเดียวกับภาคแรก ภาพยนตร์ถูกถ่ายทำเพื่อเข้าฉายในระบบไอแมกซ์ทั้งระบบ ภาพยนตร์เรื่องนี้สร้างจากเหตุการณ์ที่เกิดขึ้นใน พ.ศ. 2515 เสริมแต่งเรื่องราวเพื่ออรรถรถในรูปแบบของภาพยนตร์ชุดผีอมตะ ของ แซม เรย์มี ที่เป็นแรงบันดาลใจของทวีวัฒน์ เมื่อภาคแรก

ธี่หยด 2 (2023) เต็มเรื่องฟรี - สยองขวัญ ภาพยนตร์ 121 นาที. Tee Yod 2, ທີ່ຫຍົດ, Tee Yod 2, Death Whisperer;ธี่หยด 2. บทสรุปเรื่องเล่าที่เป็นตำนาน หญิงชุดดำที่มาพร้อมกับเสียง “ธี่หยด 2” ความน่ากลัวที่ไม่มีวิธีรับมือ ความสยองที่คืบคลานเข้ามาสู่ครอบครัวนี้อย่างไม่มีเหตุผล ยักษ์จึงต้องทำทุกวิถีทางเพื่อให้แย้มหายจากอาการประหลาด และทำให้ครอบครัวมีชีวิตรอดไปจากเสียงเพรียกสยองยามค่ำคืน "ธี่หยด 2" หนังเต็มออนไลน์ฟรี, ดาวน์โหลดหนังเต็มในคุณภาพระดับ HD, ดูสตรีมมิ่งฟรี

ภาพยนตร์เรื่อง ธี่หยด 2 ได้ทำการบวงสรวงก่อนถ่ายทำที่สตูดิโอช่อง 3 หนองแขมเมื่อวันจันทร์ที่ 24 เมษายน พ.ศ. 2566 และได้เริ่มถ่ายทำคิวแรกเมื่อวันพุธที่ 26 เมษายน พ.ศ. 2566 และถ่ายทำคิวสุดท้ายเมื่อวันเสาร์ที่ 15 กรกฎาคม 2566 ก่อนที่ในวันพุธที่ 9 สิงหาคม พ.ศ. 2566 ทางผู้สร้างได้เผยแพร่ภาพโปสเตอร์ของภาพยนตร์เรื่อง ธี่หยด 2 ออกมาให้ได้รับชม วันพุธที่ 6 กันยายน พ.ศ. 2566 มีการปล่อยทีเซอร์ตัวแรกให้ได้รับชมพร้อมเปิดเผยนักแสดงอย่างเป็นทางการ

แล้วจะดูหนัง "ธี่หยด 2" ออนไลน์เป็นภาษาไทยได้ที่ไหนบ้าง?

name: 3D Essentials - Rolling Balls 0.4a
author: danvxc
description:
NOW WITH - Real-Realtime ball reflections, better shadows, why are there three tables in that kitchen??? The back wall is now bouncy and I've changed the camera angle again!

Realtime GI, Reflection Probes, Probuilder, RT Enlighten... a ton of other stuff! All made for practice! Fixed to run at 60fps. I cannot get this WebGL version to run on iPhone for some reason.

Full scope of changes made:

- Changed speed that the ball rolls in the Project Physics settings
- Changed all lights to be realtime to reduce lightmap size (unsuccessfully)
- Messed with volumetrics to add a fog effect
- Probuilder was used to create the cage, including mirroring, smoothing, merging, combining normals, etc.
- Enlighten was used to add indirect bounce lighting without using baked light/shadowmaps
- External assets used were the house (+ contents), lightbox
- Cinemachine was used to add the tracking / switching cam (the trick is to use a third "camera" object that uses the CineMachine brain script!)
- FastTree was used to make 5000 trees, which was then culled down to approx. 100 because 5000 is STUPID.
- Other stuff I've forgotten!

name: 47 Rōnin
author: keckluis
description:
The story of the 47 Rōnin on Japanese scrolls will be brought to life in a game. This will be implemented in a sidescroller that allows players to control the characters themselves and experience key scenes in minigames. The graphics will be taken directly from the scrolls to keep the original style of the images.

The project is supported by the Stadtmuseum Hornmoldhaus in Bietigheim-Bissingen. The dataset for this project consists of 10 high-resolution photographs of Japanese picture scrolls.

Our team consists of master students from the courses "Computer Science & Media" and "Design of Interactive Media" at Furtwangen University:

Salome Dieterle
Luis Keck
Lisa Räthsel
Markus Schürmann

name: 8BqrhPYQZPJDTwjL
author: Miramana
description:
Welcome to Rover Racing!

Use the keyboard WASD keys to drive.

Use the F key to shoot your autolaser, use SHIFT to boost, but be careful, they both draw power from the same source, destroy only what stands in your way, save that precious boost.

Enemies will drop a variety of items when destroyed, these can be useful (ultra sticky goo gives you amazing grip temporarily) and or extremely annoying (shock crystals disable your vehicle temporarily!), so be careful when running the little ones over, you'll automatically pick up whatever they drop. Might be a good idea to destroy a few, and avoid the rest wink

The game is difficult to play, but very rewarding to master, using real physics in a low gravity environment, weight transfer is the most important thing, learn to move the weight of your rover around on its wheels with judicious use of throttle and brake, and you'll soon master the challenging terrain!

You score points by passing the checkpoints with the highest speed possible. Completing the track quickly will get you more checkpoints, but choosing to go fast into some checkpoints might be advantageous. Learn which checkpoints can be abused and which ones to respect!

Enjoy, and Happy Holidays!

name: AI가 만든 UI를 체험해 보세요! ( Enjoy the AI-generated game UI! )
author: DMeloper
description:
◆ 화면 우측 하단의 음소거 버튼을 해제하면 효과음과 함께 즐기실 수 있습니다. ◆

◆ 화면 우측 하단 전체화면으로 더 몰입감있게 플레이하실 수 있습니다. ◆

이 프로젝트는 AI로 실제 적용 가능한 게임 UI를 만들 수 있는지 탐구하기 위해 제작되었습니다.

[ 단축키 안내 ]
'F' 키 : AI 요소들을 찾아볼 수 있습니다.
'V' 키 : 메뉴창을 모바일-PC 디자인으로 변경할 수 있습니다.

[사용된 AI서비스 목록]
- 미드저니
   : 맨 처음 이미지를 생성할 때 사용되었습니다.
- 스테이블디퓨전
   : 생성한 이미지를 변형할 때 사용되었습니다.
제작 과정은 제 유튜브 채널에서 확인하실 수 있습니다. https://youtu.be/Ffxtq93qqU8?si=KzSTVki1wpxXHvOC

This project was born out of curiosity about how cool AI could make game UIs.

[ Keyboard shortcuts ].
'F' : Browse the AI elements.
'V' : Change the menu windows to a mobile-PC design.

[List of AI services used].
- Midjourney
was used to generate the first image.

- StableDiffusion
was used to deform the generated image.

In addition, the UI configuration was created by referring to the asset Cartoon GUI Pack.
You can watch the creation process on my YouTube channel.https://youtu.be/Ffxtq93qqU8?si=KzSTVki1wpxXHvOC

Pace Yourself - a high-octane roguelike survival game that challenges players to master advanced movement mechanics while managing scarce resources. name: ANU2024 u7310220
author: Unity Play
description:
My Proposal Prototype
Objective:
Reach the spice quota in time by gathering it with harvesters, use carriers to move them to spice fields and away when worms come.

Controls:
Left Click: Select and move carrier
Right Click: Land carrier
Middle mouse: Pan by clicking it, zoom by scrolling

Game Guide:
Left Click a carrier (blue circle) to select it.
Left Click else where to move it.
Right Click to land the carrier.
Right Clicking on a harvester (grey square) will attach it to the carrier.
Right Click again to land and place the harvester.
Placing a harvester on a Spice Field will make it harvest.
Spice Fields are constantly moving, keep an eye on them. They fade as the amount of spice lowers.
If the harvester is: grey = no spice, cyan = some spice, green = full of spice.
Be careful of the worms that lurk below the surface, if they get close to a crawler on the ground, they will target it. When they start this hunting they surface and are pinged with red triangles.
Harvesters are safe on the base (black square)
If they reach the crawler, they will swallow it and all its spice with it.
Picking the harvester up and placing it on the base (black square) will cause it to deposit its spice.
Landing the carrier on the base will refuel it, if it runs out of fuel it crashes and becomes unusable.
To beat the game deposit the indicated amount of spice by the quota before the time limit elapses.
Good Luck

Use WASD to move, use left-click to change the blade rotation direction.
You can destroy an enemy by touching it with your blade, and the game is over if you are touched by an enemy's blade.

Two difficulty levels have now been added: easy and hard. Easy mode requires only 5 enemies to defeat to succeed, hard mode requires twice as many.
Also the blades move at different speeds for different difficulties.
One enemy will be generated every 5 seconds, and one pill will be generated every 30 seconds.

The Cheese Heist:
You, the player, will control a mouse, and your goal is to collect all the cheese (yellow objects) in the map and escape the cats (enemy) for as long as you can. There will be speed potions (purple objects) that the mouse and enemy can collect to temporarily increase its speed, and catnip that the mouse can collect and shoot at the cat to make the enemies stop in their tracks for 3 seconds. description:
COMP3540 Game Prototype Submission - U7287889

In Timber Trail, you play as a lumberjack in a fast-paced, "hill-climb" style game. You face a lumberjack's worst nightmare as you traverse a dangerous mountain slope, trying to reach the finish line while dodging logs and stumps rolling down at high speed. It's no easy trek, as the logs roll much faster than the lumberjack can climb. To make matters worse, getting hit by a log or a stump will set you back or even knock you off the mountain! Dodge your way through the obstacles in two challenging levels to prove you're the boss.

name: AO Balloon Demo
author: billcrowther
description: A simple lighter-than-air balloon attached to a ballast weight with a simple string model. The balloon has AOBuoyancy forces and AODrag acting on it. The environment uses an AOFluidZone to set the density of the surrounding air, and an AOFluidEffector to set up a simple wind model. The balloon has a custom BallloonController script running on it that allows the user to inflate or deflate the balloon. The user can also change the wind speed and change the length of the string during the game. www.aerodynamicobjects.com

name: AO Vertical Wind Tunnel Demo
author: billcrowther
description:
Drop rag doll skydivers and random shaped objects into a vertical wind tunnel. Change the wind speed and see what happens.  Wind tunnel is built using a custom Fluid Zone that produces a local vertical wind that drops off with height. Objects are randomised in terms of shape and centre of mass location.                                                                
www.aerodynamicobjects.com                                               
Skydivers are built using a mannequin asset purchased from Bevans Media https://assetstore.unity.com/publishers/3631

name: AO Wind Turbine Demo
author: billcrowther
description: A simple wind turbine made from three Aerodynamic Object blades and tail fin with Lift and Drag components. The rotor and tail fin assembly is free to rotate around the mast so that it naturally points into the wind. The user can vary the aspect ratio of the blades and blade pitch angle as well as the wind speed and direction. The turbine has a simple generator model that outputs power proportional to aerodynamic torque and rotation rate. The brightness of the light is proportional to the power generated. How much green energy can you make?  www.aerodynamicobjects.com

AquaFarm Ace is a 2D time management simulation game on aquaculture where the player controls an aquaculturist-in-the-making following through the different phases of the aquaculture process, accomplishing tasks, and getting through several challenges to complete a purchase order from a customer. -After unlocking a new vehicle, a visual cue will display where to stand to control it

Astro is an endless runner where you travel through the Milky Way Galaxy, seeking to get the highest score possible while evading all obstacles in your way. As you advance through different planets and achieve higher scores, you will encounter more hurdles to avoid while maintaining your fuel for your jetpack. This game is purely a passion project, and actually my first game so any criticism or advice is greatly appreciated.                                                       
                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                           The controls are simple, with A and D used to go left and right, and space being used to use your jetpack!

Since this game is on a browser, the quality overall isn't up to par with the actual application version, so if you would like the better and official Astro it'll be here at my itch.io page: https://rodriler.itch.io/astro. Just scroll a little down, click download, and unzip/extract the files. With that, you'll have the official version of Astro!                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                       
Check out Astro on simmer.io: https://simmer.io/@rodriler/astro

Normally to pause you would press Escape, but the browser kind of interferes with key, so I also allowed Tab to be used to pause or unpause for the browser version.

name: Back to Southside of Edinburgh in 1929
author: yzh705823375
description:
Impressed by the historical buildings and diverse lifestyle of South Side of Edinburgh in the digital collection of black-and-white photographs taken in 1929 by Alfred Henry Rushbrook, we design a mini-game to bring the players back to Edinburgh 100 years ago to explore a new experience in this community. 


Old map will show after a collage story. We applied auditory archaeology to the photos and made sound design the core of the game to create a more immersive game experience. Unique two-channel stereo sounds can be heard, such as carriages, bells, and the sounds of shops, churches and other landmarks. The main gameplay is that the player needs to identify which building the fragment belongs to, according to the content, direction and volume of sounds. In public show, sound visualisation will replace sounds and make the same effects. Easter eggs and message board are also waiting to be explored.  


Memories, stories, and impressions of that time are collected and displayed in the game, all of which together constitute the rich history and culture of the South Side of Edinburgh in the recent one hundred years. We really enjoyed producing this mini-game, and cannot wait to share with you!

name: Ball Sprinter 3D: City Adventure
author: Alex4791
description:
Note: This game does not seem to be exported properly in WebGL format. I will look into this error as soon as possible. Hope to make this work online soon!

Welcome to an exploration of a forward moving ball object in a road filled with squared and rectangular objects all in the way! Navigate your journey through cities, glaciers, forests and more better seen than said. Collect pick ups of varying points to increase your high score. Discover ways to control and master the endless forward running speed by timing the left and right movements to your convenience at play. Certain white objects or other speed bump lookalikes help reduce an outburst of uncontrollable fastness. Every rate of speed affects the game's progress indefinitely. Avoid brown colored obstacles at all costs! A single collision and the game is done for. The adventure holding its own provides different ways to be overcome. Look out for special openings and tactics to your ever evolving advantage!

name: Ball Sprinter 3D: Night Shift Trial
author: Alex4791
description: Welcome to the trial version of Ball Sprinter 3D on Night Mode. In this early release, you'll explore the environments of a few early levels and ways to navigate to the finishing point on each one. The story centers itself in a night environment consisting primarily of dark and morose themes in contrast to bright and vibrant ones. The stars have apparently fallen from the sky but thankfully enough is there a completion star around every corner to indicate you have finished every level. The full version of this game will release soon in 2020.

name: BasketBallTraining
author: N_Ryz
description:
A simple game of hitting a basketball hoop.

Control.
You can adjust the angle of the ball with the up and down arrows. The power of the throw is controlled by holding the space bar. If you release the space bar, the ball will fly towards the target.

Victory conditions.
You are competing with a computer controlled opponent. Your task is to throw more balls into the basket than your opponent in ten attempts. If you find it too easy or, on the contrary, too hard, you can raise / lower your opponent's level after every 10 throws.

Hint: you almost always hit the hoop if the throwing power is between 401-419 and the ball is aimed at the inner rectangle of the basketball backboard.

Introducing an exhilarating multiplayer tank battle game! Gather your friends for heart-pounding action where victory is within reach. Engage in epic battles with a minimum of 2 players and a maximum of 4, and strive to emerge as the ultimate champion by winning 5 rounds.

Team up with a friend and control Player 1 and 2 using one keyboard, while Player 3 and 4 can wield their game controllers for precise maneuvers and strategic gameplay. Maneuver through the battlefield, strategically positioning yourselves to outsmart and outgun your opponents.

But beware, the battleground is fraught with danger. Take advantage of repair points strategically scattered across the map to replenish your tank's health and stay in the fight.

Are you ready to unleash chaos and claim victory in the ultimate tank showdown? Gather your squad, strategize your moves, and dominate the battlefield to become the undisputed champion!

name: Beatdown Breakdown Boomtastic
author: johnnyjacques
description:
Originally created for a game jam by a team of 4, “Beatdown Breakdown Boomtastic” is a 2.5D experience that combines classic beat-em-up gameplay with rhythm game mechanics. All graphics were created from scratch, 2D images were animated using Unity's skeletal animation. 3D assets were made using ProBuilder. There are slight audio issues in the webGL build, you can also download the game here :

https://davidflyr.itch.io/beatdown-breakdown-boomtastic

Summary :

Hit those beats HARD! You've been hired as a security guard at a concert, and it's your job to protect the DJ from unruly fans rushing the stage to drag him away. Finish the song to win; fail to protect the DJ and you'll get booed offstage.

Power up your punches by lining them up with the beat of the DJ's music. You help him, he helps you back-- stronger together!

Controls:

Keyboard: "WASD" to move, "Space" to jump, "Left-click" to attack, "Esc" to quit.
Controller: D-pad/L-stick to move, "A" to attack, "B" to jump.

Dans ce niveau , le joueur incarne le rôle d'une abeille perdue en ville, luttant pour éviter les nuages de pesticides et de polluants mortels. Le but ultime est de survivre aussi longtemps que possible. Avec des graphismes captivants et une musique immersive, Bee Alive offre une expérience de jeu palpitante où les réflexes rapides et la prise de décision rapide sont essentiels pour franchir les obstacles et atteindre des niveaux  score élevés. name: Blackjack
author: LZimm7
description:
Everyone loves blackjack, the classic luck/strategy casino game., and whether you're a seasoned pro or a blackjack newbie, this immersive online blackjack experience serves as a free training ground to gamble without any real risk.

A leaderboard for the highest amount of money earned by players is included in the main menu. Keep in mind that the leaderboard only accounts for money that you had when you cashed out, not your peak amount of money, so try to time your cash-out effectively. 

6 Decks are used in this game, and they are reshuffled about halfway through the shoe.

Please leave any feedback in the comments.

House Rules:

Blackjack pays 3-2: This is standard, but still needs to be specified.

Dealer must stand any 17: This is standard but still needs to be specified.

Insurance is unavailable: Insurance is a weird thing in blackjack, when to use insurance is widely debated and even unknown to many. Many people never use insurance, so I decided not to include it.

Splitting is not allowed: The application of a split is rare, as the player is unlikely to be dealt a pair. If a player is dealt a pair, it is still rare that they would split any cards besides aces or eights. On top of its sparse application, splitting is an unnecessary advantage given to the player. This game moves very quickly, and when the player loses, they can simply just play again, so I found that the dealer needed another slight advantage, which I achieved by not including splitting.

name: BlendIn
author: kakarrot97
description:
General Description

The player is assigned a color that initially matches the platform it starts on. There will be different color shifters and different color platforms on the way. When a player walks/jumps through a color shifter, the character’s color changes to that specific color enabling it to “blend in”. The player needs to avoid mismatching its character’s color to the platform's color while steering clear of other obstacles and making it to the endpoint to move on to the next level.

Goal

The goal is to match the player's color with the platform (and at the same time avoid other obstacles) and reach the endpoint. Mechanics (How to play) Player moves: Keyboard keys ‘A/Left’ and ‘D/Right’ to move left and right; ‘W/Spacebar’ to jump. Color change: Change character color when it walks/jumps through a color shifter. Color match: Match the character color to the platform. If it matches, the game continues; else the player loses.

Inspiration

Platformer: Mario, Vector, Mr. Jump Color Change/Match: Color Ball Run, Color Switch

description:
This is absolutely not what I intended to submit to the GameJam showcase.  I had been working on a LEGO RPG, I had it all wrapped up and ready to go just by the Game Jam deadline, and... I couldn't upload it.  I got a server error.  And for some reason I couldn't upload it to the GameJam site directly either.  So I panicked and selected to enter this game that I haven't worked on for several weeks instead.  Dang it.  If you want to see what I tried to upload, it's at kamawale.net/MonstersAndMinifigs, though... it's an enormous file, which is probably why I couldn't upload it.  Not sure how well it's going to play as a WebGL game anyway, to be honest.  Still... I'm kind of frustrated at having put in all that work on my game and not being able to enter it in the GameJam.  Oh well.

Oh, dang.  I'm such an idiot.  I just realized this isn't even the game I worked on recently.  This is the one I did months ago when I was first trying out the LEGO Microgame.  Oops.  Dang.  I am dumb.

description:
In School Bus Simulator, you take on the role of a school bus driver with the important task of picking up students and getting them safely to school. Your goal is to find children at three different bus stops, stop the bus at each station, and pick them up to win the game. Pay attention to your surroundings and be cautious of collisions along the way.

Controls:

Movement: Use your Arrow keys or W A S D to drive the bus.
Stop & Pick Up: Press Space to stop the bus and pick up students at each bus stop.

How to Play:

Pick Up Students: Locate the bus stops and stop the bus at each station (floor). Press Space to pick up the children waiting at each stop.
Complete the Route: Successfully pick up all students from the three bus stops and deliver them to school to win the game.
Avoid Collisions: Be careful while driving to avoid collisions with obstacles and other vehicles.

name: Captain Antonia and the Pillars of Albatross
author: CrypticAlbatross
description:
My (CrypticAlbatross) submission to the LEGO "Build Your Own Game" contest.

The Pillar Islands of Albatross are slowly crumbling into the sea as earthquakes and maelstroms rattle the world. To reverse the tide of destruction and save the people of Albatross, the explorer Captain Antonia must recover technological relics of a bygone civilization.

Gameplay features.
•	The game uses procedural generation for much of its content. From the menu you can always restart a level with a different seed. Unless you use the same seed number, every playthrough is different, some more challenging than others!
•	You can switch between four different cameras: far, near, first-person, and cinematic.
•	Five levels: prologue, the Voxelwood Forest, the Cubic Caldera, the Fractal Canyon, and Scholar's Island.

Other details:
•	I created the music using Reaper digital audio workstation.
•	I created all LEGO models using the LEGO editor asset on Unity.

name: Car Soccer
author: Unity Play
description:
It is a Unity-based game where players can play soccer by driving cars.
Almost all game mechanics and all assets are created by me.
The game currently includes a single-player mode with AI-controlled cars, offering various match setups such as 1v1, 2v2 (with an AI teammate), or uneven matches like 2v1 and 1v2.
The creation of the game is documented in a YouTube video series, where you can see almost the entire process of building the game from scratch.
Through the video series, I prepare game models, textures, scripts, and the integration of sound and music, as well as the implementation of single-player capabilities.
I am planning to create a multiplayer mode in the future.
For now, have fun playing against AI players.

Game Engine: Unity 2021.3.10f1 (URP - Universal Render Pipeline)
Models: Created by author
Music: Composed by author
SFX: Created by author

History
To clean is your life.

You have a heavy Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD) that doesn't let you feel well with the world if your house is not clean and something is out of order.

So, when you had to leave your house for a business trip and had to leave your family alone at home, you contacted a cleaning agency to make sure that your house would be clean when you came back.

And you left.

And you came back.

And the cleaning agency was not what it seemed. At your back, you found your family, your wife, your child, your dog, killed and sliced.

And the house was a mess, filled in blood, with everything in complete disorder.

And it is this disorder, not the death of your family, that requires revenge.

name: CMYK Match
author: JMGomezCobo
description:
🎮 About the game:
Dive into the vibrant world of CMYK Match, where your task is to master the art of color blending using the CMYK color model. Test your skills by matching colors with precision, and race against the clock to achieve the highest score!

🎯 What's the main goal? 
The main goal of CMYK Match is to match the randomly generated target color using sliders representing the cyan, magenta, yellow, and black (key) channels. The closer your color is to the target, the more points you score.

🧩 How to play:
• Adjust Sliders: Use the cyan, magenta, yellow, and black sliders to mix and match the current color with the target color. 
• Input Fields: You can also type specific values in the input fields for precise adjustments. 
• Check Match: Press the spacebar or click the on-screen button to check if your color matches the target. The closer the match, the more points you earn!

💡 A few tips:
• Precision Matters: The closer your color is to the target, the more points you score. Fine-tune your adjustments for better accuracy.  
• Speed Counts: You earn more points for quicker matches. Balance speed and precision to maximize your score. 
• Increasing Challenge: The game starts with a forgiving tolerance but gets more challenging as you progress through the rounds.

Test your color-matching prowess and strive for the perfect match in CMYK Match! Can you achieve the ultimate high score and master the art of CMYK color blending?

description:
I recently delved into Visual Scripting in Unity, and I am thrilled to share my experience with you! 🌐✨

🕹️ No Coding Required! 🚫💻 Visual Scripting is a game-changer for creating games and interactive experiences without diving into code. Unity's visual scripting system allows you to unleash your creativity without the need for traditional programming.

🎮 Simple Sample Game Project: 🏆 As part of my exploration, I whipped up a simple game project using Unity's Visual Scripting. From concept to implementation, the process was incredibly intuitive. I could bring my ideas to life without the barriers of coding syntax.

👨‍💻 Why Visual Scripting? 🤔 It's an excellent entry point for beginners, designers, and artists who want to get hands-on with game development. Plus, it offers a streamlined workflow for rapid prototyping and experimentation.

🌈 What I Loved:
User-Friendly Interface: Intuitive drag-and-drop functionality.
Visual Logic Flow: Easily understand and modify the game's logic.
Quick Iteration: Make changes on the fly without recompiling code.

name: COVID Simulation
author: jliao1998
description:
University of Calgary - CPSC 581 Project 0

Some tips for playing this COVID Simulation:

First, we can do tests on mask/no mask, quarantine/no quarantine, compared how many days it takes to infect all the students.

Second, we can test the social distancing and contact time under mask/no mask, quarantine/no quarantine policy - test two extreme condition: (Distance = 0, Contact Time = 5) & (Distance = 5, Contact Time = 0). Test another situation that (Distance = 1 and Contact Time = 1, or any other value you can choose). This should be enough to showcase that social Distance has more weight in the infection.

Third, we can test vaccination percentage. Roughly test 10%, then 20%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90%, 95%, to demonstrate how it can achieve herd immunity (WHO suggested roughly 70%).

All of the simulation tests above have only one infectious student in the beginning.

Fourth, we can also test how fast it takes to infect all the students by putting more 'trojan horses'.

name: Crystal Radio
author: Keexi
description:
A short rogue-like that changes based on the music you have playing. Now testing controller support. The majority of controls should be functional. The bumpers shoot and dodge, the triggers switch weapons (for now), and the DPad controls the music player. Up to play, down, to pause, hold down to stop, right for next song and left for previous. Controller input on WebGL apps is very spotty, but at least Xbox controllers have been confirmed to work. 
Controls:

Player:
e: Pick up items
Aiming: mouse position
Left click: shoot
Right click: dodge
w: move up
a: move left
s: move down
d: move right
Scroll mousewheel: change weapon
Tab: enlarge map
r: reload
m: Passive item info

o: previous song
p: next song
j: stop
k: pause
l: play
i: song info


General info:
Each song will provide a different benefit while it is playing.
New songs drop from bosses. They appear as discs.
Passive items can also drop from bosses.

name: CWC Game Jam 2021 - Ben-Hur-Ry Up!
author: Zhiu_1234
description:
TLDR:
W: Boost (has cooldown)
SPACE: Combat trick against green cubes (has cooldown)
MOUSE: Camera
A+D: Move sideways (the chariot moves forward on its own)
Please read carefully, as the MVP project doesn't hold your hand when it comes to accessibility.
You are Ben, one of the brave chariot racers and you want to be the first one finishing two laps without dying. Dying?! Oh yes,... This race is not for the meek. You can tackle and boost your way to glory! Use the "w" key to get a small boost and hit that "space" button to get a super force field to attack the enemies. The enemies are those green thingies riding the chariots, by the way...
Oh yeah, and because your engine-horses are so super smart, they will drive the chariot for you automatically. So lean back and kick those opponents out of the race. You have full 360° view with your mouse so keep it wisely to keep track of both what's happening in front of you and behind you. If you wish, you can override the auto-pilot and use "A" and "D" to steer.
This game jam was fun, but also super intense. I tried to squeeze in as much free time as I could, while still having my 9-to-5 job and the everyday chaos happening around me. At least I could dig up around 10-12 hours and invested it in learning some stuff about racing car AI and fighting against physics.

name: Defense Clicker
author: JeaNiX
description:
This is a little personal project I've been working on for some months. On January 2021 i began to learn unity and C# from scratch, and this is the progress so far.

Can you defend your ground by clicking on the evil monsters? Massive waves of enemies just waiting to get on the other side, and only YOU are there to stop them.


Currently there are 3 levels with only one boss, but each level is unique because it offers a new type of enemy. See them all ;))

There is already implemented different enemy behavior, different attack skills, critical chance, acid damage, magic resist and armor values are different for each enemy, fire damage over time, slowing (used by the Wiz skill) and many more is already written.

This project is in development, so I've added the core functionality, but in the future I plan to add more enemies (they are already present), bosses (also hidden), characters and their new abilities.
All 2d and audio resources were taken from itch.io, and I thank the authors for the permission to use them in my project. This is my first project and I'm very happy to introduce it.
Please feel free to test and comment.

name: DemoBasicTWR
author: FBNL
description:
! Pensez bien à activer le son !

Le programme ci dessus s'adresse en priorité aux élèves en cours de phase BASIC TWR. Des rappels sont affichés dans le menu accessible via la touche "echap" une fois la simulation lancée.

Tout autre utilisateur est le bienvenu, et pourra tenter d'apprendre "sur le tas".

Dans la demo ci dessus :

-scenario d'une durée de 20 min,
-4 trafics piochés aléatoirement dans une base de donnée,
-creation, déplacement et remplissage des strips par l'utilisateur,
-communications contrôleur par l'utilisateur,
-retour sur la performance à l'issue des 20 min.

Globalement, la demo présente des milliers de scenario en fonction de quel trafic apparait à quel moment, et de comment il est traité par l'utilisateur.

A des fins d'amélioration de l'outil, merci par avance pour votre éventuel retour.

description:
"Nature is in danger. A foreign army has slowly taken over the forest and the surrounding area. Fulfill the role of a druid and protect this mystical forest from the invaders. Track down the mysterious general that has been haunting the school to eElderwood certainly is an unique experience.

Controls:
- 'w,a,s,d' to move around.
- Click and drag right mouse button to move the camera.
- Press '1' to channel the strenght of a bear, knocking back enemies.
- Press '2' to channel the might of a phoenix, crossing a short distance in the blink of an eye.
- Press 'Left Shift' to channel your healing ability, this only works in combat.
- Your health is visible in the top-left corner of the screen, when it reaches '0', the game is over.
- A mini-map will be at display in the bottom-left corner of the screen, showing you the interesting locations.
- Press 'Escape/Esc' to bring up a pause menu, allowing you to go to the main menu or to continue your fantasy experience.

Good luck on your journey!

Pro tips:
- to collect items, try actually going to them 
- sprinting will be useful at a later point in the game :)
- try moving closer to objects to click them (you may have to click several times on an object for something to happen, IDK why)

The goal of this game is to, of course, escape the room, but also reach the glass-walled platform before the timer runs out. Have fun!

name: Explore the Graffities of Atlantis - Abandoned Aquatic Park in Mexico City!
author: BenoitEncounters
description:
YouTube video of our exploration (Intro): https://youtu.be/6s-EeZ12cu4

Use WASD on your keyboard and your mouse to move around like in a video game and become an urban explorer yourself!

On mobile, go to: https://hub.link/maDiwdr

Atlantis is an abandoned aquatic park in Mexico City, which has become half forbidden half a spot to visit. Artists go there to make graffiti, street art, as well as music videos, and more! The maze-like style of the place made it particularly interesting for me to scan because I am in search of making interactive videos and experiences that are participatory. But unlike video games, my content is sourced in reality and has a documentary approach to it. The idea is to enable the audience to explore places by themselves.

My Fujifilm DSLR camera kit which I used for the 3D scan (6K resolution): https://amzn.to/3hnVHMA
If it's out of stock you can get the former model (cheaper and just as good): https://amzn.to/3AaXwFj

name: Extreme Space Cab v1.0
author: Sharkitty
description:
This Game was made by Hayley GUILLOT (Sharkitty) and Nigel BLOEMENDAL (SurudoiRyu)

In this futuristic open world city, people need space cabs to get around, and you're the best one out there!

With your sporty hovering car, take clients and bring them to their destination. You gotta go fast while avoiding other space cars and pedestrians 
to keep your clients happy and get lots of Cyber Bucks!

Don't wreck your car!
Hitting stuff will damage it, and if you get too much damage: It's GAME OVER!
Watch out not to break stuff or you'll have to pay a fee!

Use your well earned money at the garage to repair your car and get upgrades!
These upgrades change your stats and are visible on your space cab, which makes it look way cooler!

This game feature:
- An open world futuristic city with custom made assets.
- An awesome space cab created solely for this game.
- An upgrade system that changes your cab model to make it look more impressive on top of the stat improvements.
- A fully functionnal UI with custom digital painted sprites.
- A random job system and working economy.
- NPCs get mad at you when you hit them.
- Damage and repair system.
- Real Hover physics.
- You can boost or make an impulse that makes your cab jump.

Now take the wheel and go make lots of Cyber Bucks!

Note: Since I got sick during the last week we had to develop this game, we got delayed and there has been a big rush at the end. Some part of the map may not be flawless because of it, but we did our best to release a complete game. We hope you will understand the situation. We also hope you will have fun with our game, enjoy!

name: FabYutNori
author: greenstorm2669
description:
Traditional Korean Wood Game is now released and visible on https://play.unity.com/mg/other/webgl-builds-382488. In the latest update, the last bug has been fixed, and a new rule has been added. Now, you can hold Yut results when it's 4 or 5, and those results can be combined as you wish. Yut Nori, also known as Yunnori, is a traditional Korean board game that is particularly popular during the Korean Lunar New Year. The game involves a board, usually made of cloth or wood, and is played with four wooden sticks, called yut sticks, which serve as dice. Each side of the sticks has a different value, dictating the movement of the players' pieces on the board.

The objective of Yut Nori is to move all of one's pieces, or "mal," around the board and back to the starting point. The game can be played by two to four players or teams, and it encourages strategic thinking and cooperation, especially in team play. The unique aspect of Yut Nori is the possibility of getting extra turns or movements based on the outcome of the stick throws, making the game unpredictable and exciting.

Yut Nori is not only a game of luck but also of strategy, as players decide the best way to move their pieces in response to the throws, and how to best utilize the special moves allowed by certain combinations of the yut sticks. It's a game that brings families and friends together, fostering a sense of community and celebration during festive occasions.

7 Feb 2024 Major update to integrate the use of a rule that was communicated to me only at the end of January - the rule of making all throws when a 4 or a 5 is rolled and storing them to choose the most strategic combination later. Indeed, beyond creating a dropdown list and subsequent choice buttons, the computer was not able to click on them and wait for updates. Now, with the addition of a few variables and timers, it can click the last created button when necessary. As for the strategy, I have my ideas, but it will require more development.

name: Feed the Dogs 29.2.24
author: rmcc1983
description:
This started as a junior programmer pathway tutorial but I have built on it!

Read the story & instructions. Choose your character.  Choose your difficulty level to change starting lives, amounts of food, spawn start delay, spawn interval, powerup duration and what visual assistance you have - tooltips will help you decide. Enter your name to personalise displays. Move using WASD, arrow keys or the D-pad or left stick of a gamepad.  Feed the border collies bones using 8 (PS4 square), German Shepherds steaks using 9 (PS4 cross), and St Bernards cookies using 0 (PS4 circle).  German Shepherds need 1 piece of food, Collies need 2, St Bernards need 3...unless you miss too many dogs, in which case each subsequent dog will require an extra piece of food.  Keep missing, and eventually the dogs will require yet another piece.  Collect the star powerup to temporarily get sandwiches which they can all eat, and it only takes one to feed them (throw using backspace or PS4 triangle). Collect the shield powerup to be temporarily safe from dogs crashing into you. Collect hearts for extra lives. Mouse over the dogs, food etc in game for tooltips (and enjoy the custom mouse pointer)!  Pause using P (or PS4 R1), quit using escape.  The more dogs you feed, the faster they run! Don't let the dogs hit you, and don't feed them the wrong food - you will lose lives! Survive 2 minutes to win.

Gamepads are supported (I have tested with PS4 controller on WebGL) and the WebGL game can be played on mobile devices as I have added touch controls (including a virtual keyboard).



If you would like to complete my feedback form, please go to https://forms.office.com/r/ATTPTGmjPN?origin=lprLink



I am trying to learn, so constructive feedback very welcome. Please be kind!

name: Final project: Creative Core - Enter The Portal
author: Amario92
description:
My final project for the Creative Core Unity course. It features and showcases many of the things I learned during the course.
Although this project took me a long time to create, there are still things I wish I could've done better and things that I could've implemented to enrich the user experience.
However, I'm glad it's done!

WebGL has a bug at the start of the game that prevents you from looking around. Simply start the game then exit fullscreen and then fullscreen again and click the mouse to remove the cursor!

The project is called 'Enter The Portal' and it's a 3D platformer. There are two levels with one bonus level where I tweaked the camera angle to give the user a different perspective.
Simply guide the character through the portal to progress to the next level.
I wanted to make fun-looking levels for the user to explore and feel at ease with.

I did make a third level but the scope and vision of it changed as it became too big!

The assets were from the asset store and the music was from opengameart.org

name: Final Project for the Creative Core Pathway
author: Yrisel
description:
My final project for the Creative Core Pathway.

It was quite a long 2 weeks (free time) journey for this project alone (aside from the whole pathway experience), learning lots of stuff, from skyboxes, water, underwater, props, animations, lighting and materials, object pooling, etc.

I enjoyed this learning experience a lot. I'm looking forward for my next challenges.

Notes: I was running out of time to deliver this final project. Sadly, there were things that I didn't managed to add to the project. But there are a lot of others that did managed to get into the final release like:

- Dynamic skyboxes
- Time of day
- Lights turn on and off depending on the time
- Dolphins spawn at random (pre-determined) locations. Yes, there are dolphins roaming in the water :D
- Sounds! Waves, footsteps and background noise.
- Water, underwater effects, waterfalls!
- UI

And more!

I hope you enjoy this project as much as I do, and did developing it.

name: Forgotten Dungeon 2
author: Unity Play
description:
Forgotten Dungeon 2 is an addictive hack-and-slash action RPG.
Slay skeletons, zombies, and other monsters as you explore dungeons.
You will gain experience for each kill, and sometimes, enemies will drop items.
When you level up, you can upgrade your strength, dexterity, intelligence, vitality, and spells.
Increase your attack/damage and defense by equipping yourself with better weapons and armor.

Choose between a sorcerer, archer, and warrior in this Diablo style RPG adventure game. Build experience and level up by defeating enemies.
Equip your character with items that are found, won in battle, or purchased from various vendors. There are a ton of different items to choose from in this game.

When you level up, the player has a choice of certain skills and attributes to improve and expand upon with their earned experience points.
Items and weapons collected which are not equipped can be sold at the shop for gold. Attacks can be melee based or magic based. Click on the target enemy to battle. 

Your magical skills can be selected from the left of the screen. Using these decreases the mana levels but deliver extra attack damage.
You can go back to town at any time by clicking the town button beside the skills button, and returning through the portal brings you back to where you left off.

Special attack types can target weakness areas of enemies, so choosing when to use the proper magical attacks is important.
The equipment you have selected actually shows up on the your character in the game.
Strength increases damage. Dexterity increases attack speed and dodge chance. Intelligence increases magic speed, magic damage, and mana max. Vitality increases life max.

author: Pericky
description: Help Victor Frankenstein learn the secrets of life and death: In the novel "Frankenstein", Mary Shelley often symbolizes light as a symbol of knowledge. As light can shed light on darkness enabling us to see and understand more of our surroundings/world, knowledge also helps us understand the world and the unexplored/unknown darkness. Unfortunately, too much light can also blind, making one ignorant of their surroundings. In Walton and Victor's case, they had too much knowledge and failed to see the consequences and were ignorant of what their actions could do. Therefore the main idea of my game is to use scrolls/knowledge/light for good like helping you advance in the game, but be careful of not getting too ambitious and try to get too many scrolls because you may become ignorant of your surroundings and fall to your death. Use a and d to move left and right, space to jump. Let the scrolls guide you through the dark unknown and find the secrets of life and death. Good Luck!

Hopefully the full game will be available on Steam or itch.io sometime soon, but for now, this is all that I'm releasing. It is just a quick and simple walkthrough that explains the basic mechanics of the game. Also, there is a free play level, where you can run around and do stuff. In that scene, you can practice aiming your bow and arrow, and work on your building. This was a lot more difficult than I anticipated, but I'm overall pretty satisfied with the way it came out. I used Blender for the 3D modeling and Visual Studio for the scripting. I would love to hear your feedback as long as you keep the comments friendly and appropriate. name: GameDev.tv game jam 2022 - Death is only the beginning
author: Zhiu_1234
description:
This is my submission for the GameDev.tv​ game jam 2022 with the theme: Death is only the beginning.
In this jump-and-run platformer, you don't have to start over when you die. Upon death, the player's corpse becomes part of the level and you can use the corpse to reach the other side of lava lakes or to block the patrol of enemies. But be careful - you can only die once and the next time you'd die, it's lethal.
There's also a checkpoint system that allows you to retry the level at the furthest point you've progressed so far. Hint: When "picking up" the checkpoint, the player can die again!
Control:
Arrow Keys / WASD --> moving
Space Key --> jumping
Mouse --> clicking buttons in the menu

name: Glub
author: Unity Play
description:
1. English
2. French

----- 1. English -----

End-of-studies project on Unity (3WAcademy 2021, session 09, during the health crisis).

Completion time: 1.5 months.

This project is designed for Cross Platform: you can play it on mobile, WebGL or PC.

This game is a Casual and Arcade game for 7 year olds. The player controls Glub who has to hit cubes to get stars.

The movements are done in 2D on a finite dimension board. The view is in 3D, centered on Glub and the camera follows the position of the character.

Cubes fall from the sky at random positions and at regular intervals. They roll away from the board. Collecting cubes earns points.

A level lasts 30 seconds. An alarm clock that extends the time drops 5 seconds before the end of the countdown; collecting it moves to the next level and the timer restarts.

Failure rules: when Glub leaves the board or when the countdown is at 0.

A number of levels have been created offering various challenges.

Best score is saved.

The user inputs are real time, i.e. you can for example play on a touch terminal and switch to keyboard-mouse or joystick control without interruption. The mobile control is inspired by Sky made by That Game Company.

The project is subject to Responsive Design: on mobile in particular, the game supports portrait or landscape orientations, which influences the gameplay (portrait: 1 finger and move, landscape: 2 fingers and move and rotate camera) and the display of data on the screen (position of elements, dimensions ...).

Bonuses to be collected according to the score levels obtained are planned, but it is not realized at this time. I focused on the core of the game.

On the development side, this Unity project includes the Universal Render Pipeline, the new InputSystem, Singletons, ScriptableObjects and Unity Events. All scripts have a custom display by EditorScripting (I had to recreate the FlexBox CSS behavior).

The UI animations still have some bugs and I'm not satisfied by the architecture

name: Hanabi Game
author: shokkun
description:
"Hanabi Game" is a simple yet strategic puzzle game where you combine bubbles of the same color to compete for a high score. As you progress, planning the placement and merging order of bubbles becomes crucial, requiring thoughtful and strategic gameplay. The game's colorful effects and music add to the fun during merges. While it's quick to pick up and play, repeated sessions allow for skill improvement, making it a game with depth that keeps you coming back for more. 
I am currently a third-year university student, and I developed this game in collaboration with my lab members, showcasing it at our school festival.

Game optimized for English: Haunted Gates is a hidden objects serious game that injects electrical and computer engineering content into the gameplay. Play 4 levels and practice what you have learned while having fun finding both educational and non-educational objects.  Our intent in designing this game is to make it playable and inherently educational at the same time. Learn as you play using image word association. The more you play, the more you remember the digital components, binary conversions, gates, etc. This work was funded by a Lockheed Martin Grant: "e-STEM: Improving STEM Education and Retention through Technology
Enhanced Teaching and Learning", PI: Dr. Rasha Morsi

Te propongo un trato para salir del Infierno con tu alma intacta.
En el Infierno hay cuatro calabozos con diversas habitaciones y en cada habitación vive uno de mis demonios.  Ellos se alimentan de oro o del alma de algún incauto que pase frente a ellos.
En cada calabozo deberás alimentar a todos los demonios y salir por donde llegaste. Si superas los cuatro calabozos, te dejaré salir del Infierno con tu alma intacta.
Al inicio de cada calabozo te daré suficientes monedas de oro para alimentar a todos sus habitantes al menos una vez. Pero si te quedas sin oro, el siguiente demonio devorará tu alma y te quedarás en el Infierno para siempre.
¿Qué decides? ¿Quieres salvar tu alma?

name: Hotels Inc. - Prototype
author: Clara_Krieg
description:
Snapping is currently really wonky.

Minimum Goal: 

To build a hotel manager/tycoon game, where you start with a plot of land and build a hotel on it. You will hire employees to run the main aspects of the hotel (i.e. cleaning, reception, cooking, etc.) which will cost money. Once the hotel is built and employees hired, you will open for business and begin to attract guests, which will increase your revenue. You lose if your funds reaches a negetive value.

Long-term Goal:

Allow you to build a multiple level hotel with a rating system that increases guest flow.
Give the player more lots to purchase to have multiple hotels at once.
Allow the player to sell a hotel to gain lump sum amount, as well as add loans to get you more features up front, but at a cost.
Add in marketing campaigns that cost per day, but bring in more guests based on hotel ratings.

ตัวนี้เป็นเวอร์ชั่นต้นแบบ ใช้เวลาเล่นไม่นาน(~3นาที) แม่หอยก็อิ่ม กลายเป็นร่างสมบูรณ์แล้ว
มีด่านเดียวก่อนนะ แล้วจะเพิ่มให้ในเวอร์ชั่นถัดๆไป ทั้งประเภทของอาการ ศัตรู และอุปสรรค รวมถึงระบบการเล่นที่จะพัฒนาขึ้น รับรองว่าต้องสนุกขึ้นเรื่อยๆแน่นอน!

ตัวเกมเล่นได้เลยทันที ไม่ต้องโหลดลงเครื่อง ฉะนั้นหายห่วงเรื่องความปลอดภัยหรือไวรัสได้เลย

พร้อมแล้วก็กลายร่างไปเป็นแม่หอยกันได้เลย!

Game Created for Tawatnewt Fans! By Tawatnewt!!

Hey! We've got a game for you to try. It's called HoyFrenzy V1.0 (by Tawatnewt).

This is a game I created myself, and it's about a mother pearl oyster searching for her babies while also foraging for food along the way to stave off hunger.

This is just the prototype version, and it won’t take long to play (~3 minutes). Once the mother pearl oyster is full, she transforms into her complete form! There's only one level for now, but in future versions, I'll be adding more types of food, enemies, obstacles, and improved gameplay features. I guarantee it’ll be even more fun!

The game is playable directly—no download required. So you don't have to worry about security or viruses.

Dear reader, 
My name is Docter Elizabeth Eams and I need your help. If you are reading this something must have gone terribly wrong. I have been working for almost 13 years on an alien that I call Frailien, But the truth of the matter is that I do not know who I can trust among my colleagues since Fralien is capable of a great deal. As a contingency plan, I have a build-in connection between me and Fralien.  For if or when Fralien is controlled without the secret code that I haven't shared with anyone. If this message is released that means that Fralien has killed and destroyed against its own will. You are the chosen one. It is not sure how you will find my lab and surroundings but be prepared for the worst...  
I need you to collect documents so we can figure out how to stop Frailien.
If you accept this quest press "Enter" if not, who knows if there is time to wait for someone else. 
It is up to you if you dare!

Arriving on the shores of a mysterious island, you discover ruins of a once-mighty tower. But can it still be climbed? Perhaps, if the island lends you its power... 

~~~

CONTROLS: WASD or arrow keys to move, mouse to look around

~~~

I built this game over the last 2 weeks or so, in spare evenings, and I'm really happy with how it turned out! I put together a tool to auto-build Lego models from ProBuilder mesh shapes, so that I didn't have to hand place every brick in Unity or stud.io. I also tinkered around with giving the minifig character more of a stop-motion look, by forcing their animations to a lower framerate than the game.

I hope you enjoy the maze, it should be a fairly short game, though I'm not exactly sure - I know the routes already when testing!

O Jogo do Peixinho Dourado é um jogo divertido e educativo para todas as idades.

O objetivo é desenvolver o raciocínio lógico e a matemática de uma forma discreta e lúdica.

Veja as regras:

1. São 15 peixinhos, sendo 1 dourado e 14 verdes.

2. Dois jogadores se alternam para retirar os peixinhos verdes, podendo retirar 1, 2 ou 3 peixinhos por vez.

3. O jogador que ficar com o peixinho dourado perde o jogo.

Será que você consegue encontrar a melhor estratégia para vencer? Experimente e descubra! 🐟

Bom jogo.
Fernando F.

name: John Conway's Game Of Life
author: AfroDog
description:
John Conway, a British Mathematician, created the Game of Life in 1970. It is a zero-player game simulating cellular multiplication.

This project was interesting to code and presented the challenge of neighbor awareness on a 2D grid.

The rules are as follows:
1. If a cell has less than two neighbors, it dies by underpopulation.
2. If a cell has exactly two or three neighbors, it survives to the next generation.
3. If a cell has more than three neighbors, it dies by overpopulation.
4. If an empty tile has three live neighbors, a new cell is born.

name: June 2022 Update -> Spacebot Concept - Prototype 2
author: CreativeTherapyCo
description:
June 15 Update: Now you can shoot and defeat enemies,  get hurt if hit by enemy fire and fail or complete the first mission. 

About this project: We created Spacebot during buddy jam and are looking to get early feedback on this prototype as we continue development. Read on for more details and to get a sense of the vision for this game.

### Description

Spacebot was sent to the Nu Solar System for one simple job: to harvest oxygen. But how can she do that when the human colonies there need her help? Free 1000 human colonies and help them survive, using diplomacy or hostile warfare.

### Gameplay

Free captured human colonies, defend them from attack, and manage their resources! Your goal is to get to 1000 human colonies and (hopefully) keep them as healthy and happy as possible.

### Theme

Spacebot meets the 1000 theme because his goal is to save 1000 human colonies.

### Controls

Left Stick (gamepad), WASD/arrow keys, stick (joystick), primary 2D axis (xr controller)
Aim and Fire / Interact with button: Right Trigger (gamepad), left button (mouse), Top (touch screen), Trigger (Joystick), prime action (xr controller), space (keyboard)

name: Kinda Heroes: The cutest RPG ever!
author: Unity Play
description:
Kinda Heroes is a classic medieval RPG made by one indie guy!

Welcome to Riverstone - a tiny medieval village in the middle of nowhere! This place hasn’t seen any heroes yet. Choose a character and begin your adventure! Upgrade combat and cooking skills, complete quests, rescue Woody and become a real hero!

KEY FEATURES
• Classic medieval RPG
• Side View & Scroll gameplay
• Tiny build size, no DLC
• Offline gameplay, no Internet access is required
• Exciting story
• 8 different heroes with unique combat style
• Switch heroes at any time and use common inventory
• Advanced mechanics based on movesets and timings
• Craft and augmentation system
• Cooking
• Tons of equipment
• Unique skills
• Various quests
• Monsters and bosses, each with unique features and movesets

name: Knauf Newslettery
author: Nayunh
description:
Hallo lieber Tester! Danke für Deine Teilnahme an meiner Bachelorarbeit! :-)

Ein kurzes Tutorial und Anmerkungen:

1. Unten kannst du deine Email-Adresse angeben und dann auf "Anmelden" klicken oder die Enter-Taste drücken. Achtung: Beim Drücken von "Alt" oder "Alt Gr" erscheint ein Kommentar-Fenster von Unity. Das einfach wegklicken. Alternativ kannst du auch irgendwas oder sogar gar nichts ins Feld eingeben - es funktioniert trotzdem!

1. Unten rechts ist ein "Sound an"-Button, der standardmäßig ausgeschaltet ist. Diesen kannst du gerne einschalten!

3. Der Button "Alles renovieren" ist nur für Testzwecke. Damit kannst du das vollständig renovierte Haus betrachten, ohne jede einzelne Renovierung durchzugehen. Beim erneuten Drücken des Buttons kommst du wieder in den vorherigen Zustand zurück.

Danke nochmals für deine Teilnahme!
Maurice

name: La Mora - A journey in time
author: allangaunt
description:
Welcome to this Unity Showcase Demo of "La Mora - A journey in time"

Time is Broken. This should be the Golden age of Mankind. Someone, something, has changed our history, and left us picking up the pieces. You are part of a group tasked with repairing the damage... However, something went wrong. You can't remember your mission and the machine that brought you here is broken. Your only clues are vague memories, along with a name; La Mora. You have to piece together your mission, your memory, and your wits, before time as we know it, is gone for good!

Enjoy your tiny journey in time!

- Allan and the La Mora Team

[Controls]

[WASD] - Move
[MOUSE] - Turn Camera
[E] - Action Button
[SPACE] - Jump / Climb Ladders
[TAB] - Open Inventory / Quest Log
[ESC] - Pause Menu

name: LEGO Race
author: Mathematik42
description:
LEGO Ideas username: Speckhofer Enterprises

In this racing game, you can choose one out of twelve different racing cars and try to overtake the AI-controlled opponents! The track is located in a landscape with hills, mountains and ... sheep!

I built the LEGO models in BrickLink Studio. After importing them into the Unity LEGO Microgame, I implemented the controls and car physics, including air resistance, rolling resistance and lateral friction forces. In order to increase performance, I created my own material resembling LEGO 2x2 tiles for the road. The blue and red items (which give you a speed boost or slow you down) as well as the sheep were created using Behaviour Bricks.

Controls:
WASD - control car
Mouse - rotate camera
R - reset car

Download the game: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RdphcrvvWYZOAjTx7M0B2xVEwV4aVJbX/view?usp=sharing

[The standalone version has better performance and graphics. In the online version, try using non-fullscreen mode for better frame rate.]

author: jhonholand4
description:
サッカー日本代表vsサウジアラビアテレビ放送・ライブ配信・ライブ放送・放送・生放送・生中継 2024年10月10日

Live►►🔴➡️ https://worldsportshd.com/jp-soccer/

Live►►🔴➡️ https://worldsportshd.com/jp-soccer/

🔴https://worldsportshd.com/jp-soccer/


【10月10日】サッカー日本代表 vs サウジアラビア代表 ｜テレビ放送・ネット配信サッカー日本代表が、2024年10月10日（木）にサウジアラビア代表と対戦する。

　会場はサウジアラビア・ジッタの「キング・アブドゥッラー・スポーツシティ」で、キックオフ時間は2024年10月10日（木）27時00分（11日3時00分）の予定となっている（日本時間）。

　サウジアラビア代表対日本代表の試合は、ネット「DAZN（ダゾーン）」／「ABEMA de DAZN」で独占生配信される。

　地上波テレビでの放送はないが、Android TV™機能やスマートテレビ対応の機種などで「DAZNアプリ」をインストールすると、テレビでも視聴可能となる。日本代表は、10月10日（木）に行われる『FIFAワールドカップ26アジア最終予選（3次予選）』（キング・アブドゥッラー・スポーツシティ／サウジアラビア）にてサウジアラビア代表と試合を行う。

　8大会連続8度目のW杯出場を目指す日本代表は、アジア2次予選で朝鮮民主主義人民共和国、シリア代表、ミャンマー代表と同組のグループBに入り、6戦全勝の首位で突破すると、最終予選ではオーストラリア代表、サウジアラビア代表、バーレーン代表、中国代表、インドネシア代表と同組のグループCに入った。

　9月の最終予選2試合では、初戦のホーム中国代表戦で7－0、第2節のバーレーン代表戦では5－0と、合計12得点無失点と圧倒的な強さを示し、2連勝を飾った。しかし、第3節の対戦相手であるサウジアラビア代表は、日本代表、オーストラリア代表に次ぐ3番手（ポット3）としてグループCに入ってきたチームだ。ここ最近、サウジアラビア代表は結果が伴っていないが、警戒すべき相手であることは間違いない。

　なお、日本代表は過去に最終予選でサウジアラビア代表とアウェイで2度対戦しているが、2017年、2021年とともに0－1で敗戦。厳しい戦いを強いられてきた歴史がある。ただ、最後の対戦は2022年2月1日に行われた前回のW杯アジア最終予選で、日本代表はホームで、南野拓実、伊東純也がゴールを決めて、2－0と勝利した。サッカー男子日本代表vsサウジアラビア代表丨日本時間何時から？日程・試合開始時間／FIFAワールドカップ2026アジア最終予選
10月の国際マッチウィークでFIFAワールドカップ26アジア最終予選に出場するサッカー男子日本代表・SAMURAI BLUEは、第3節のアウェイ戦でサウジアラビア代表と激突する。ここでは、同試合の放送予定について日本時間で紹介しよう。10月の国際マッチウィークで、FIFAワールドカップ26アジア最終予選に出場するサッカー男子日本代表・SAMURAI BLUEは、第3節のアウェイ戦でサウジアラビア代表と激突する。

この試合は相手チーム国の第2の都市であるジッダにあるスタジアムにおいて、現地時間10月10日の夜にキックオフされる。日本と現地の時差は、−6時間であることから、日本時間では日が変わった11日の明け方より試合が始まることとなる。

グループCに同居する両チームは、9月の第2節までを終えた時点で日本が1位（2勝0敗）、サウジアラビアが2位（1勝1敗）と、ワールドカップ出場権を獲得できる上位2チームに入っている。このため、どちらのチームもグループ内の難敵を倒して勝点を積み上げ、上位をキープしたいところである。

ここでは、アジア最終予選のサウジアラビア対日本の試合について、放送予定を日本時間で紹介しよう。
■概要
大会名：FIFAワールドカップ26 アジア最終予選（3次予選）
対戦カード：サウジアラビア vs 日本
会場：King Abdullah Sports City Stadium（サウジアラビア・ジッダ）
日時（日本時間）：10月11日（金）03:00 KO
※日本と現地の時差は −6時間

name: Look out! Crazy drivers.
author: CookieDoughDev
description:
Challenge a friend with a race to the end of the road, but keep an eye out for the crazy drivers!

Here is my spin on the first prototype project from the Create with Code series! I added camera switching, a bunch of stacked obstacles, some oncoming cars that can steer left and right to make it harder to dodge, and lastly local multiplayer for that competitive goodness!

Hope you enjoy it!


The Controls:
    Player 1:
	WASD - To drive forward, backwards, steer left and right.
	Left control or E - To toggle the camera to the driver seat.
    Player 2:
	Arrow keys - To drive forward, backwards, steer left and right.
	Right control - To toggle the camera to the driver seat.

Primitive objects used, are from the Create with Code series - https://learn.unity.com/tutorial/set-up-your-first-project-in-unity?uv=2020.3&courseId=5cf96c41edbc2a2ca6e8810f&projectId=5caccdfbedbc2a3cef0efe63

description:
How good a driver are you? Find out!

In all "Endless" difficulties, max speed increases incrementally up to 10 times, with the final level being when you reach a score of 2560+. Making it harder the longer you're in the game.

Changelog April 3, 2020

Added 10 Normal Mode levels and 10 Hard Mode levels for a total of 23 levels (including the 3 Endless Mode difficulties)
Added a "Controls" menu
Added a "Level Select" for the non-endless modes
Added a "Pause" menu to escape to the Main Menu or exit the game
Added a text at the bottom right of the screen to indicate your current level in Normal and Hard Modes

"Game Over" screen now allows you to choose to restart the current level or quit to main menu
On Normal and Hard Mode levels there is a screen in between each level to give you a rest between levels
Each level in Normal and Hard Modes increases the distance to the goal (which is currently invisible [plans to change that in future hopefully]) and increases the speed.
Hard Mode has a 50% base speed increase over Normal Mode on top of the 1st person only.

Changelog April 2, 2020

Adjusted the rain to be less white, and thinner so it looks more realistic.
Added some ambiance
> Rain sounds
> Engine sounds for both player and NPC vehicles
> Some relaxing music for the drive!

Changelog April 1,2020

Added image to: Main Menu and both Difficulty menus, so it's not blinding white.
Added a "Night Mode" (i.e. "Expert Mode")
Added rain to the endless modes
Adjusted car lighting to be way less intense and more realistic
Increased fog density in "Hard Mode" so the cars become visible closer.

Updated "did't" to "didn't" on Game Over screen. ;)

Endless Night Mode:
Incredibly dark.
Headlights are auto on, and can't be toggled.
Fog is very dense, making cars become visible fairly close to player.
Increase base speed by 50% compared to other modes.

Controls:
Auto forward movement
"A" and "D" move left and right
"F" to toggle Headlights (disabled in "Night Time Mode")
"C" togg

name: Mayan Doom
author: tomasmacias
description:
Procedural LEGO Platformer

A 3d platformer where level are procedural generated with increasing difficulty as it level up. It's my first "serious" game in Unity so I hope you enjoyed it. Please leave me any feedback on the comments :)

Synopsis

A recently discovered mayan temple has reveal that the actual End of the World will occur in December 2022 and not in 2012 as interpreted before. Luckily, this temple also shows that the old mayan gods (probably aliens) hided a secret high-tech weapon to be deployed at the time. But only if humanity proofs to be worthy in a series of randomly generated set of platforms, which will test both dexterity and cunning.

Why procedural?

- It makes the game more durable as you can replay it many times and it has, theoretically, infinite levels (Actually not, because of graphics and performance problems at very high levels)

- It enhance to learn how to play and get skills to avoid any unforeseen situation, rather than memorizing the timing of the level with repetition.

- It makes testing more funny (egoist thought of developer)

- The algorithm creates very interesting levels and situations that I, as essentially programmer, could not find out so easily. 

WebGL Performance

The game was developed on Windows Platform and it has much much better performance there. I tried to optimized it a little bit for WebGL but got out of time. I think I should remove some objects since the temple is very heavy for WebGL and also all the vegetation. If you have any tips please leave a comment.

You should be able to play some levels and get the concept of the game: like a demo. But I recommend you to get the Windows version if you have enjoyed it. (https://thebretonnian.itch.io/mayan-doom)

One workaround is to play with the  free look camera to make a kind of 2.5D View or placed it as cenital view in order to reduce the amount of objects in the Screen. Also reduce the look sensibility may help.

name: Microgame
author: TurTleZR
description:
What is my game about?
You are a soldier who has awakened and is helped by the informant Letix to win the game. You have 200 health points. There are 3 levels. The higher the level the more difficult it gets. 

In the first level you have 8 enemies, they are the Hover_bots, there are 5 big Hover_bots and 3 small ones. The big ones have 100 health points and the small ones have half of it. You get a pistol to help you as well as a shotgun that is in the ground. With the shotgun you can take out a Hover_bot with only one shot, but you have to be at close range.  When you take out a Hover_bot, health points are dropped on the ground, giving you 40 health points. When you have completed the first level, you can go to the altar, a sacred room from the map itself. There is a rocket launcher near the altar, with which you can take out the Turret_Bots faster.  The launcher only has a range of 15 meters, so it doesn't do much good to shoot from a long distance.

The second level is about taking out 2 Turrets and 4 Hover_bots. This is not easy.  In each corner there are health points that you can take, they give you 100 health points.

At the third level you get a jetpack at your disposal because with it you can fly to 4 different platforms where you get health points in case you have little life. You can also shoot enemies from the platforms, but you run the risk of being quickly eliminated.
In this level you have to fight against the final boss, he has 2000 health points and gets 12 health points deduction per shot, but he is not alone, he has 4 protectors helping him, each of them has 800 health points and gets 6 health points deduction per shot. The final boss is surrounded by 4 walls, each 2.5 meters apart. 
What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to eliminate all the enemies without dying.

<Control>
Move:  W(up), A(left), S(down), D(right)
Jump: Space Bar
Dodge: Move(W,A,S,D) + Space Bar

Enter the Shop: Press “E” on the circle

Get the Item: Just to go to Item

name: ML-Breakout
author: maraudingpangolin2
description:
This game was developed using Unity and ML-Agents and uses reinforcement learning to train a neural network on how the game should be played.   First, a clone of the Atari Breakout game was developed in unity.  Then the ML-Agent was trained to move the paddle left or right while being provided observations about the ball, paddle, and blocks.  The Agent was given rewards for hitting the ball with the paddle, breaking bricks, and a penalty for losing the ball.  By allowing the ML-Agent to train for increasing amounts of time, the Agent will learn what actions maximize the rewards and minimize the penalties, effectively learning to play the game.

In addition to developing the required game and a trained agent, we decided to expand the project to offer a multiple levels, a leaderboard, multiple trained models, and deployment of the game using WebGL to Unity Play.  This game demonstrates the learning behavior by offering three different levels of model training: 

     - Beginner - the ML Agent was trained for 7 minutes.
     - Intermediate - the ML Agent was trained for 11 minutes.
     - Advanced - the ML Agent was trained for 44 minutes.

This project was developed by Jonathan Reuter (reuterjo@oregonstate.edu), and Joel Strong (stronjoe@oregonstate.edu / www.jdstrongpdx.com) as part of their Capstone course at Oregon State University.  We used a GitHub repository with CI/CD and workflows found at: https://github.com/ReuterJo/ML-Breakout

Hearing I ask | from the holy races, From Heimdall's sons, | both high and low; Thou wilt, Valfather, | that well I relate Old tales I remember | of men long ago. 2. I remember yet | the giants of yore, Who gave me bread | in the days gone by; Nine worlds I knew, | the nine in the tree With mighty roots | beneath the mold. 3. Then Bur's sons lifted | the level land, Mithgarth the mighty | there they made; The sun from the south | warmed the stones of earth, And green was the ground | with growing leeks. 5. name: MONKEY BANANA GAME
author: TheEndlers
description:
Introducing the ultimate primate showdown: Monkey Banana Game! In this epic 2D battle, you'll take control of either a monkey or an orangutan as you face off against your opponent on a series of treacherous jungle platforms. With only one objective in mind -- to knock your adversary off the map -- you'll need to utilize all your skills and cunning to come out on top.

Featuring fast-paced gameplay, intuitive controls, and vibrant graphics, Monkey Banana Game is sure to be a smash hit among players of all ages. Whether you're a casual gamer looking for a quick pick-up-and-play experience or a seasoned pro looking to dominate the competition, this game has something for everyone.

But don't just take our word for it! Check out these rave reviews from some of the top gaming critics: IGN: "Monkey Banana Game is the most fun we've had in ages. With its addictive gameplay and charming visuals, it's a must-play for any fan of 2D platformers." - 10/10
Metacritic: "A true masterpiece of game design. Monkey Banana Game is a game that will keep you coming back for more, time and time again." - 100%
Gamespot: "Monkey Banana Game is the surprise hit of the year. Its simple premise and addictive gameplay make it a must-play for any gamer." - 9/10
Eurogamer: "Monkey Banana Game is a game that will go down in history as one of the greatest 2D platformers of all time. Its fun, fast-paced gameplay and gorgeous visuals make it a true standout." - 5/5
Kotaku: "Monkey Banana Game is the kind of game that reminds us why we fell in love with gaming in the first place. It's a game that's impossible to put down, and one that we can't recommend highly enough." - 9/10

name: Mr. Tee's Wild Run
author: PolygonPros
description:
Mr. Tee loves kicking cans down the street. But crates are bad for his health! Help him run for as long as you can, by running, dashing, stomping, jumping, and double-jumping through the cans, and dodging the crates. Hitting multiple cans in a row scores combos - extending your running time, and occasionally boosting your health. If you run out of health or run out of time, Mr. Tee's run is over. GL & HF! 
****** Controls ****** 
Jump = Spacebar
Double-Jump = Spacebar x2 (pro-tip: you can jump extra times after colliding with cans or crates) 
Dash = Right Arrow Key 
Stomp = Down Arrow Key 
Restart Game = Enter

name: My RPG in-progress
author: Azalore
description: This isn't ready for release or even demo yet, this is just a proof-of-concept build. Here I show all the features I have currently built into the game, including: (1) grid based movement system. (2) Item/inventory system with lootable, sorting, stackable, usable and equippable items. (3) Equipment system with stat affects and buffs, and specific equipment types/slots. (4) Complete Shop/NPC system with buying/selling/ and customizable inventory. (5) Enemy AI with follow, auto target, chase radius and attack range/speed. (6) Full combat system with melee, bow, and magic attack styles, combat text, animations, and health/mana bars.
